## Context

Cumulative error counters in infra/scripts/observability.sh persist an acknowledgement offset before CloudWatch accepts the matching datapoint. A transient put-metric-data failure therefore causes the next interval to compute zero from an already-advanced baseline, permanently losing the positive delta. The same copied construct affects seven metric streams across six code shapes, including the G2P block omitted from the original five-site census.

## Proven root cause

Each affected block writes total to its offset file before running aws cloudwatch put-metric-data. Whole-script runtime probes showed offset 2/source 7/failing AWS becomes offset 7, and the next successful run publishes 0 rather than 5 for every stream. Removing only error suppression does not recover the count. Original feature stories explicitly require these observed failures to publish metrics and trip alarms.

## Repair plan

- Reorder each of the six concrete publish shapes so the matching offset advances only after a successful CloudWatch call. Cover replication, voter, merge-change, deploy, both shared autodeploy-marker streams, and G2P.
- Preserve the script systemd exit-0 contract and existing logging behavior: AWS failure stays best-effort for the overall probe, but the failed metric remains unacknowledged.
- Keep zero-delta publication behavior unchanged; a successful zero publish may acknowledge the observed total. Preserve reset handling where total below offset retries total.
- Add a whole-script PATH-shim regression oracle that drives the real script, fails each targeted AWS metric once, proves the offset is byte-identical after failure, then proves a successful retry publishes the accumulated delta and advances the offset. Include zero/reset controls and both shared-helper metrics.

## Testing

- Run `pytest -q tests/scripts/test_observability_offsets_6a65.py tests/scripts/test_observability_exit.py`.
- Run `make lint` and `make typecheck`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] All seven cumulative counter streams advance their offset only after the matching successful AWS publication, checked by the whole-script test.
- [x] A failed publication leaves the targeted offset byte-identical, checked for every stream by the whole-script test.
- [x] A subsequent successful run publishes the accumulated delta and then advances the offset, checked for every stream.
- [x] Reset handling retries the reset total after failure, and zero-delta behavior remains compatible.
- [x] observability.sh still exits zero when an individual AWS publication fails and on a healthy run.
- [x] The held-out oracle is observed RED before the fix, GREEN after the fix, and RED again under the original pre-acknowledgement mutation.
- [x] Repository lint and typecheck gates pass.
